name: Melao Salicylic Acid 2% Solution 30ml
description:
Product Name: Melao Salicylic Acid 2% Solution 30ml
Origin: Made in China

Key Information

For external use only

Patch Test Required: Always do a patch test before first use

Skin Safety: Do not apply on damaged or broken skin

Eye Contact: Avoid direct contact with eyes

Pregnancy & Lactation: Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding

Sun Protection: Use sunscreen and limit sun exposure while using this product and for one week after discontinuation

Usage Duration: Not suitable for prolonged or continuous use
